issue.body:
Hello, I am trying to deploy my app via FastAPI/Starlette, but font requests are being responded with "text/plain" in utf8 encoding causing errors. 

Can you add these lines to responses.py:

// add mimetype for fonts
mimetypes.add_type('application/vnd.ms-fontobject', '.eot')
mimetypes.add_type('application/x-font-opentype', '.otf')
mimetypes.add_type('application/x-font-ttf', '.ttf')
mimetypes.add_type('application/font-woff', '.woff')

so the guess_type function does behave properly?
issue.title: responses.py does not handle MIME Types for fonts (.woff, ...) properly
